description: Defines the AnonymousSignature class which implements request signing behavior (namely, no signing) for AWS SDK.

classes.name: AnonymousSignature
classes.description: Provides anonymous client access by implementing SignatureInterface without signing requests.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Returns the request object unmodified, implementing request signing with no actual signing.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Returns the request object unmodified, for pre-signing with no actual signing.
